{{Youmay|the weapon|the [[Shotgun (CR90 corvette)|corvette]] of the same name}}
[[File:Shotgun.jpg|thumb|right|A shotgun used in the Galactic Civil War]]
{{Quote|Shotguns? I didn't think anyone used projectile weapons anymore.|Sergeant [[Boss (clone commando)/Legends|Boss]], after encountering [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] with shotguns|<ref name="Star Wars: Republic Commando">''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]''</ref>}}
The '''shotgun''' was a powerful, heavy, and compact [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] or [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]] that emitted several bolts or pellets at once when fired. They could often hit multiple targets or eliminate one target with a single blast. However, its damage decreased as range to the target increased, since the pellets scattered if fired from too far away; this made the [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] more suited for close-quarters combat.

A common shotgun weapon was the [[blast cannon]], used by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Which was a variant of the standard [[E-11]] with a beam splitter, as opposed to a conventional shotgun. The [[TriShot]] could be considered the [[Pistol/Legends|pistol]] form of a Shotgun, since it fired multiple laser bolts, but only three instead of the usual five. The elite [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Rebel SpecForces]] team [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]] used both shotguns and tri-shots. [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] slavers sometimes used them, as did some [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

Slugthrower versions include the [[Scatter gun/Legends|scatter gun]] and [[C-M Frag Storm heavy shotgun|C-M Frag Storm]]. A [[Flechette launcher/Legends|flechette launcher]] could also be considered similar to a shotgun in functionality, throwing hundreds of razor-sharp flechettes over a small area.
